requirements.title: Entitlement and usage enforcement

requirements.title: Payment confirmation and reconciliation

Persist duplicate/out-of-order event handling, idempotent entitlement update and reconciliation of pending/unknown outcomes. Verify callback authentication and replay protection; retain financial history and exclude sensitive payment data from logs.

requirements.title: Renewal, cancellation and subscription settings

Show accurate current, pending and failed billing state, retry safely and preserve allowed record access under expiry policy.
